# All about Legendary Crafting/Legendary Crafting

![](/uploads/ajaxGallery_11_nukaknights-post-legendary-crafting.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

## LEGENDARY CRAFTING

All weapons and armor, with a few exceptions, can now be crafted in legendary at the workbench itself. Of course, the perks are **always re-rolled by the RNG**.

Exceptions (cannot be crafted legendary):

Anti-Burn Training Pistol, Binoculars, Blade of Bastet, Camden Whacker, Commie Whacker, Cave Suit, All Radiation Protection Suits, Flare Gun, Father Frost Helmet, Mereorite Sword, Robe of Mysteries, Paddleball, Pearl Eyes, ProSnap Deluxe Camera, Voice of Set, Injector, Protest Signs

Update: ~~Chainsaw, Drill, Chainblade~~ (Can drop and craft legendary since September 13th, 2022)

All weapons/armor are **tradable under the same rules as before**. So, for example, a manufactured handmade or cleaner can still be traded, a T-65 or crusader pistol cannot.

To craft legendary weapons you need the following ingredients:

## ARMOR

- 
1 Star: 1 Legendary Module + 1 Legendary Core
- 
2 stars: 2 legendary modules + 3 more legendary cores
- 
3 stars: 3 legendary modules + 5 more legendary cores

## WEAPONS

- 
1 Star: 2 Legendary Module + 1 Legendary Core
- 
2 stars: 3 legendary modules + 3 more legendary cores
- 
3 stars: 4 legendary modules + 5 more legendary cores

## POWER ARMOR

- 
1 Star: 2 Legendary Module + 1 Legendary Core
- 
2 stars: 3 legendary modules + 3 more legendary cores
- 
3 stars: 4 legendary modules + 5 more legendary cores

The **Secret Service Armor** can be legendary “re-rolled” with these ingredients. However, you can now craft the armor pieces with 2 legendary modules each, without legendary cores.

If you haven't already, you should now buy and collect **Legendary Modules** from the Legendary Merchant.

**Legendary Cores** can be obtained as rewards from events and daily operations:

- 
Scorched Earth: 5 cores
- 
"Cryptic", "A Colossal Problem": 8 cores
- 
Project Paradise & Free Range gives 4-8 cores (8 if all 3 animals are still alive)
- 
Daily operations have a chance of 1-3 cores (Oldest rank)
- 
No cores from gifts or buckets
- 
“Meat Week” and “Fasnacht”: 1-2 cores for “good” results, 1-3 cores for “best” results
- 
All other public events also have a chance of 1-3 legendary cores
- 
Legendary Cores cannot be traded or discarded.

## THE CRAFTING WORKS IN 2 WAYS:

Non-legendary weapons are rolled legendary with modules/cores.

- 
For this you provide e.g. Get a weapon, go to mod and roll it with a legendary mod.

Already legendary weapons are “re-rolled” with new perks.

- 
To do this, go to “Modify” and roll a new legendary mod onto a weapon.

How useful the legendary “re-rolling” really is is of course the question. I'll probably throw most weapons/armor into the legendary machine rather than re-rolling them. With power armor you might be able to “re-roll” some of it due to the weight.

In the attached **PTS** **video** you can see the production or re-rolling of a "pepper shaker", which will be given as a reward at the meat week event. (No, unfortunately it will no longer drop with Explo.)

If you have any questions about the legendary production, please write them in this post.
